Subject: Observability & Ops: onboarding prep for OptimaHealth

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost breakdowns were super helpful. We're ready to start an observability-focused onboarding with Redwood and want to make sure we cover dashboards, tracing hooks, an error taxonomy, alert routing, and runbooks for SRE/Oncall.

Can you share a high-level implementation checklist and any pre-requisites you need from our side (agent access, sample traces, team contacts)? I've attached our current infra diagram for reference.

Also: who from Redwood will own dashboard templates vs runbook creation? We'd like clear owners so our onboarding sprint can be scheduled.

Thanks,
Marcus

Head of Platform Engineering, OptimaHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Observability & Ops: onboarding prep for OptimaHealth

Hi Marcus — great to kick this off.

Short answer: Redwood will own the onboarding plan and provide dashboard/runbook templates; OptimaHealth will provide infra credentials (read-only), a list of critical services, and an on-call contact. Below is a concise implementation checklist and the Ask list for week 0.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (prep): get access, share infra diagram & critical service list, confirm SRE contact
- Week 1 (instrumentation + traces): tracing hooks, OpenTelemetry config, sample traces collected
- Week 2 (dashboards + alerts): dashboard templates, baseline alerts, error taxonomy applied
- Week 3 (runbooks + handoff): finalize runbooks, runbook run-through with SRE, oncall playbook

Week 0 Ask (what we need from OptimaHealth):
- Read-only access to metrics/trace endpoints (Grafana/Prometheus/Jaeger endpoints or cloud provider role)
- A list of 5 critical services and their owners
- SRE oncall contact for scheduling a 60-minute kickoff (proposed times shared below)
- Any compliance constraints (data retention, PII redaction)

Deliverables from Redwood:
- Observability mapping spreadsheet (attached) that maps services -> metrics -> dashboards
- Starter dashboard JSONs and alert rules for critical services
- Tracing instrumentation guidance (OpenTelemetry snippets, sampling recommendations)
- Error taxonomy seed and suggested tagging conventions
- Runbook template and one completed runbook per critical service

Attachments: observability-mapping.xlsx (service->metric map), runbook-template.md

Next steps:
1) Marcus: confirm SRE oncall contact and available time slots for kickoff (we listed 02/12 and 02/13 in the shared calendar).
2) OptimaHealth: drop the infra endpoints and critical services list into the Drive folder linked below.
3) Sergio & Laura: please review the mapping sheet and flag any additional Redwood pre-reqs.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: observability-mapping.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]
[attachment: runbook-template.md (md, 6KB)]

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/D-OPT-202602 — please add notes under 'Implementation tasks' so Solutions can see progress.

Please reply in-thread with any blockers.

- Marissa

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OptimaHealth — CS handoff: implementation roles & week 0 tasks

Ack and noted. A few tech notes for the kickoff/Week 1 planning:

1) Tracing hooks: we'll standardize on OpenTelemetry. For services running in k8s we can add an init-container to auto-instrument if languages support it; otherwise we'll share small language-specific snippets. Sampling: start with 10% global, bump to 100% for critical transactions during debugging windows.

2) Tagging conventions: service, env, deployment_id, request_id. We'll include tracing tags to tie traces back to logs and metrics.

3) Dashboards: I'll prepare starter Grafana JSONs for the 5 critical services listed in the mapping sheet. Each dashboard will include: latency p50/p90/p99, error-rate 5xx/sec, throughput, and a small traces panel linked to Jaeger/trace explorer.

4) Alerts & routing: propose two alert channels — PagerDuty for P1s (oncall), Slack channel for P2/P3. Need Optima to confirm PagerDuty integration and escalation policy preferences.

5) Runbooks: Laura, I'll hand over sample traces and typical failure signatures so you can draft runbook steps tied to trace patterns.

I'll have the Grafana starter JSONs and instrumentation snippets ready by end of Week 1 (EOD 02/20).

— Sergio
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
